calculation.description: Cross-sectional residual returns are formed by subtracting the equal-weight 15-asset benchmark return. The factor favors assets with recent relative weakness over 10 and 5 trading days, with a small 5-day component and scaling by 40-day residual volatility. The signal is lagged one completed day to avoid look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Positive aggregate IC and ICIR across 1,795 daily observations, with strong 2024-2026 performance and weaker but positive 2027-2033 observations. Small 15-asset cross-section implies uncertainty is assessed across dates and regimes.
